title: C23 nadoba
prompt: Low-angle shot of a tall shattered glass specimen vat on a stone pedestal, liquid and glass shards burst outward, a shapeless glowing orange chaos creature mid-transformation escapes from it, its body rippling between beast, bird and slime forms, two smaller copies of it already crawling away across the floor, crackling bright orange lightning, orange chaos smoke. No people, no hands. Background: cold dark teal dungeon laboratory, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.
